# Neocom

> Neocom provides an AI-native commerce experience platform for brands and retailers. Its products help shoppers discover, compare and configure products in a retailer's online store.

Neocom refers to the company and platform. Neo Commerce GmbH is its German legal entity. Neocom uses “Agentic Storefront” for the shopping experience that its software enables. The retailer operates the store and handles checkout.

## Company and platform

- [Neocom company facts](https://neocom.ai/facts): Company identity, product scope, integrations and examples of retail implementations.
- [Platform overview](https://neocom.ai/platform-overview): How Neocom's shopping experiences work with existing storefronts, product data and commerce systems.
- [About Neocom](https://neocom.ai/about-us): Company background and founders.
- [Imprint](https://neocom.ai/imprint): Official legal entity and registration details.

## Products

- [Shop Agent](https://neocom.ai/products/shop-agent): Conversational shopping assistance that helps shoppers ask questions, find products and compare options.
- [Shopping Quiz](https://neocom.ai/products/shopping-quiz): Guided selling through questions and product recommendations that retailers configure.
- [Configurator & Bundler](https://neocom.ai/products/configurator-bundler): Product configuration and bundling for purchases that involve compatible products, components or accessories.

## Documentation

- [Neocom Docs](https://docs.neocom.ai/): Setup, integration and configuration guides for Shop Agent and Shopping Quiz.
- [Neocom Docs Markdown index](https://docs.neocom.ai/llms.txt): Full technical index covering integration, product setup, tracking, analytics and reference material.
- [Product data feed](https://docs.neocom.ai/getting-started/product-data-feed.md): What product data to provide and how Neocom reads it.
- [Shop Agent quickstart](https://docs.neocom.ai/shop-agent/quickstart.md): Prepare the catalog and test a Shop Agent placement.
- [Shopping Quiz quickstart](https://docs.neocom.ai/shopping-quiz/quickstart.md): Build, preview and launch a Shopping Quiz.

## Optional

- [Customer stories](https://neocom.ai/case-stories): Retailer implementations and reported results.
- [Neocom Resources](https://resources.neocom.ai/): Articles, reports and webinars on commerce and product discovery.
- [Contact Neocom](https://neocom.ai/contact-us): Contact options for businesses.
